name: Incident investigation and corrective actions
summary: After an injury, near miss or property damage, the site, operations or safety manager gets the investigation written up from the evidence: a timeline, the immediate and underlying causes, actions with owners and dates, and a register that follows each action until a check shows it worked.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work and the form of this one: the investigation lead's notes and evidence as the only authority, stated column headers with a stop when one does not match, owners and dates only from people, suggested actions marked as not agreed, a register carried to verified closure across update runs, reporting read from the company's own rules and confirmed by its qualified person, every gap written as a question, and nothing sent, reported or recorded until a person decides.

sources.contribution: Labels in place of names before any analysis, with the key kept apart; a numbered evidence log and a timeline before any cause; every cause tied to evidence, an unsupported cause never a root cause; actions ranked by the order of controls with an owner, a date and a cause link; care before a record is shared widely.

Immediate, contributing and root causes kept apart; an analysis that stops at a person's act is not finished; asking whether this has happened before; actions that leave the organisational cause untouched are a gap.

Asking for the procedures and permits that were meant to be in force for the task, as bearing on causes and not on blame; earlier incidents on the same equipment or task as one of the kinds of evidence to gather.

For every cause, one action that puts this occurrence right and at least one that keeps it from happening again; a dated check on every action; no action counted as working before its check result is written down; a status on each action until it closes.

A check should look for the intended effect, not just finished work; a preventive action that only repeats the corrective one is a gap; a serious hazard needs a stopgap control until the permanent fix is in.
